Hi Sophie —

Thanks for sending this over. We reviewed FinServ's list and prepared a tracked redline with two notable items that often come up: (a) limited retention exception request under Section 4.2, and (b) an expanded audit right in Section 8 that we usually narrow to information-security-specific audits. I attached our redline (Redline_from_Redwood_Legal.docx) and a short SCCs checklist that maps our controls to the EU SCCs clauses.

On SOC 2 access: we can provide a read-only SOC 2 Type II report via our secure portal. We require an NDA for full report access; if procurement prefers a SOC letter instead we can provide a summary immediately. Let me know which you prefer and we will initiate the portal invite.

About signature routing: for speed we recommend DocuSign with parallel routing to avoid back-and-forth. If FinServ needs an exec exception (e.g., longer retention), please indicate that in your redline and confirm who the approving signatory will be on your side. If an exception is needed, cc your legal lead and we will escalate to our General Counsel and Sales Ops.

Attachments: [Attachment: Redline_from_Redwood_Legal.docx (Word)], [Attachment: SCCs_matrix.xlsx (Excel)]

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Hi Sophie —

Appreciate the clarity and the collaborative redline. Quick internal note and proposed path:

- Retention: we are willing to grant a 24-month retention exception limited to logs and case files directly associated with fraud investigations, subject to additional controls (encrypted at rest, access only to designated investigators) and a quarterly review. That will require signoff from our GC (Emily Ross) but does not require product changes.

- Audit rights: we can narrow the audit language to security and data lineage relevant only to the scope of the contract and require scheduled, scoped audits with notice.

Next steps I propose: 1) Laura to prepare a final DPA with the two exceptions tracked and an exec approval memo; 2) Connor to send DocuSign envelope for parallel signature routing to expedite; 3) Redwood to send SOC 2 portal invite once NDA is signed.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/rooms/abcd-1234-finserv-dpa (will be live once Laura uploads final DPA)

If that timeline works for you, Connor will send the DocuSign and Laura will route the final for GC signoff today.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this quickly.
